title: Committed Serve Charter: fidelity bands, error-credit calculus, and notice lifecycle
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: produce a contract-ready SLA and operational spec for Dedicated capacity that moves beyond a single 'throughput' line item to a Service Fidelity framework. The spec must: (1) define discrete fidelity bands (Nominal / Degraded / Critical) tied to measurable signals, (2) prescribe error-budget accounting windows and sequencing, (3) provide a clear credit computation formula that can be automated by billing, (4) codify notice/escrow/repair timelines and escalation ladders, and (5) describe autoscaler interlock behavior and fleet-control knobs that enable graceful degradations. The document should be suitable for inclusion as a customer-facing contract appendix and as an internal engineering playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Fidelity bands defined with numeric thresholds for both throughput (tokens/min or tokens/sec) and latency (p95, p99) with example thresholds
Error-budget arithmetic and sliding-window semantics documented and validated against historical traces
Credit calculation formula with worked examples and guardrails for short-duration outages

Notice and remediation lifecycle (automatic detection, immediate mitigation, customer notification windows, escalation to on-call, credit calculation and invoice adjustment) drafted and legally phrased
Implementation tasks for telemetry, billing hooks, console UI, and legal contract language created and owner-assigned
updates: 2026-03-10 — Kickoff: PM/Eng/Legal aligned on shifting from single throughput guarantee to multi-band Service Fidelity approach. Decided to tie bands to two axes: committed tokens-per-minute and p95 latency under steady-state traffic.

2026-03-11 — Eng discovery: identified missing per-tenant quantile telemetry for p95/p99; ENG-75421 created to add instrumentation and export to SLA dashboard. Also noted edge-case when committed tokens are unused for >72h — need clause for 'dormant capacity'

2026-03-12 — Legal: recommended term 'Service Fidelity' to reduce implication of absolute guarantee. Requested explicit maintenance and force-majeure carve-outs and a 24h cure period before invoice-level credits are applied

2026-03-12 — PM drafted preliminary credit formula for review: Credit = clamp( (CommittedTokens - ServedTokens) / CommittedTokens * MonthlyCommitFee, 0, MonthlyCommitFee ). Follow-up: define CombinedDeficit when both throughput and latency fail — propose weighted sum with latency weight configurable per contract.
2026-03-12 — UX: Console product task created to surface fidelity bands and active degradation reasons to customers. Link to design brief: DES-98127
